seoTitle: Utica Community Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Utica Community Schools starts Aug. 31, 2026, and ends June 15, 2027. See breaks, half days, conferences, exams, official PDF, and ICS download.
schemaDatasetDescription: Districtwide 2026–27 calendar dates for Utica Community Schools, including the first and last day, breaks, holidays, no-school days, half days, conferences, exams, and marking-period endings.
heroSummary: Utica Community Schools starts Monday, August 31, 2026. Elementary students have a half day on the first day; the district overview does not list a half day for secondary students. The last day is Tuesday, June 15, 2027, with a half day for all K-12 students. Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, Mid-Winter Break February 15–19, and Spring Break March 29–April 2. Good Friday is also a no-school day on March 26.

customSections.label: How to Read the UCS Calendar
customSections.content: Not every UCS half day or conference date applies to every student. The district uses separate elementary, secondary, and all-student schedules, so families should check the grade-level label on each date.

groups.label: Half days apply to different student groups
items: August 31 is a half day for elementary students, not a districtwide half day.
October 1 is a secondary half day, October 14 is an elementary half day, and January 15 and June 14–15 are half days for all students.

groups.label: Conference schedules vary by school level
items: October 6, October 13, February 24, and March 3 are evening conference dates; the overview does not label them as half days or closures.
March 10 is an elementary half day, but the overview does not state a reason.

groups.label: Secondary exam half days in January and June
items: January 13–14 and June 11 are secondary-only exam half days.
January 15 is a half day for all students and still includes secondary exams; June 14–15 are also all-student half days.

groups.label: Teacher DPPD No-School Days
items: UCS lists four Teacher Full Day DPPD dates when K-12 students do not attend: September 16, October 21, November 3, and January 27.

customSections.label: Half-Day Dismissal Times Vary by School Level
customSections.content: These are the school hours currently published for 2025–26. UCS may update them for 2026–27, so confirm the current schedule before arranging pickup.

table.footnote: Check the UCS calendar page or the student’s school page for current hours.

customSections.label: Grade Levels Change in Fall 2027
customSections.content: The 2026–27 school year still uses UCS’s mixed feeder configurations. Beginning in fall 2027, every school will use K-5 elementary, grades 6-8 middle school, and grades 9-12 high school groupings.
